description:
[read-only] A queue and its items in order, with each item's state (queued · publishing · scheduled · posted · failed · skipped), booked or projected slot, and attribution status.

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard; required once the account is in more than one organization). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.
